### 2. Localized Bug Fix

Several code sites carry the unmistakable signature of narrow corrective patches rather than design:

- **`UpgradeServerVersion`** ([`ConfigHandler.cs` L605–663](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L605-663)): migrates a legacy `requestHost` encoding (`path;host` joined by semicolon) to the split `path`/`requestHost` fields introduced at `configVersion = 2`. This is a data-migration fix for a prior design mistake. The silent `catch {}` at L659 is a further tell.

- **`AddServerCommon`** sort value logic ([L790-791](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L790-791)): `maxSort++` is called but the post-increment value is never stored — `vmessItem.sort = maxSort++` assigns the value *before* increment. This is almost certainly a latent bug, not a fix, but indicates the sort field was bolted on after initial implementation.

- **`GetTcpingTime`** ([`SpeedtestHandler.cs` L212](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/SpeedtestHandler.cs?L212)): uses `timer.Elapsed.Milliseconds` (the fractional milliseconds component, max 999) rather than `TotalMilliseconds`. This is a pre-existing latent bug, visible as residual debt at this commit.

- **`ResolveSip002`** 2022-blake3 branch ([`ShareHandler.cs` L561](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ShareHandler.cs?L561)): the `if (rawUserInfo.Contains(":"))` guard was added to handle a new format where credentials are not base64-encoded. This has the shape of a targeted compatibility fix.

- **`SetDefaultServer` overload** ([`ConfigHandler.cs` L349](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L349)): the dual-list fallback pattern (`lstVmess` first, then `config.vmess`) reads as a fix for a race condition or stale-state bug where the active server wasn't being found in the filtered list.

---

### 3. Refactor

- **`BaseForm` / `BaseServerForm` inheritance hierarchy** ([`BaseForm.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Forms/BaseForm.cs), [`BaseServerForm.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Forms/BaseServerForm.cs)): the thin base classes share a static `config` field and custom icon loading, suggesting prior per-form duplication was consolidated.

- **`AddServerCommon`** ([`ConfigHandler.cs` L768](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L768)): extracts shared pre/post-add logic across all five `Add*Server` methods, reducing duplication. The signature and calling pattern is consistent with a refactor that followed the addition of multiple protocol types.

- **`LazyConfig` singleton** ([`LazyConfig.cs` L10](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/LazyConfig.cs?L10)): centralizes config access and core-type resolution previously scattered through `V2rayConfigHandler` and `V2rayHandler`, replacing earlier direct `Config` parameter passing in some paths.

- **`MainFormHandler` singleton** ([L16-18](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/MainFormHandler.cs?L16-18)): several commented-out private fields (`_updateUI`, `downloadHandle2`, `_config`, `_v2rayHandler`, `_selecteds`, `_workThread`) are visible debris from an extraction refactor that moved functionality out of `MainForm` itself.

- **`GetStdTransport` / `ResolveStdTransport`** pair ([`ShareHandler.cs` L185](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ShareHandler.cs?L185) and [L764](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ShareHandler.cs?L764)): symmetric serialization/deserialization helpers extracted to serve both VLESS and Trojan share-URL handling.

---

### 4. Architectural Scaffolding

- **`ECoreType` + `CoreInfo` + `LazyConfig.InitCoreInfo()`**: the pluggable-core architecture ([`ECoreType.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Mode/ECoreType.cs), [`LazyConfig.cs` L67-202](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/LazyConfig.cs?L67-202)) is a designed extensibility scaffold enabling new cores to be added by appending to a registry list. The enum gaps (11–21 suggest reserved space for future proxy-protocol cores vs networking-layer cores) reinforce intentional design.

- **`EConfigType` polymorphism via `VmessItem`**: using a single `VmessItem` entity as a universal server record — with `configType` as discriminant — is an architectural decision to avoid model proliferation. The tradeoff (fields like `alterId`, `flow`, `alpn` are meaningless for many types) is visible debt from this scaffold.

- **`Job` win32 job object for process lifecycle** ([`MainForm.cs` L35](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Forms/MainForm.cs?L35), `Global.processJob`): bootstraps OS-level child-process cleanup so cores are killed when the GUI exits, an infrastructural concern separate from any feature.

- **`Protos/Statistics.proto` + gRPC client generation** ([`.csproj` L47](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/v2rayN.csproj?L47)): the protobuf toolchain integration (`Grpc.Tools`, `<Protobuf Include=...>`) is scaffolding for the statistics subsystem, not a feature per se.

---

### 5. Dependency Migration (evidenced, ambiguous scope)

The [`v2rayN.csproj`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/v2rayN.csproj) declares:

```xml
<TargetFramework>net48</TargetFramework>
<LangVersion>preview</LangVersion>
```

With NuGet packages: `Grpc.Core 2.46.3`, `Google.Protobuf 3.21.5`, `Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.1`, `NHotkey 2.1.0`, `ZXing.Net 0.16.8`, `log4net 2.0.15`.

The `net48` target and `LangVersion=preview` combination suggests a migration from an earlier .NET Framework version (likely .NET 4.5/4.6) occurred at some point in this branch's history. The large commented-out block in [`StatisticsHandler.cs` L39-53](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/StatisticsHandler.cs?L39-53) (manual extraction of native gRPC DLLs) shows a prior approach to gRPC distribution that was superseded by NuGet package management — the fossil of a dependency migration. **Ambiguity**: without commit history accessible at this hash, the exact migration boundary cannot be confirmed from code alone.

---

### 6. Documentation / Configuration

- **Embedded sample files** ([`.csproj` L26-35](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/v2rayN.csproj?L26-35)): `SampleClientConfig.txt`, `SampleServerConfig.txt`, `SampleInbound.txt`, and four `custom_routing_*` files are shipped as embedded resources. These are configuration templates, not code.

- **`Global.cs` constant block** ([L8-225](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Global.cs?L8-225)): the `#region 常量` section (eleven core release URLs, protocol constants, cipher lists, domain strategy lists) is effectively application configuration stored in code rather than in a config file. Additions to these lists (`ssSecuritysInSagerNet`, `fingerprints`, `domainStrategy4Freedoms`) represent documentation/configuration tasks.

- **Bilingual error messages** (`ResUI` resource class, `.zh-Hans.resx` files per form): all UI-facing strings are externalized into `.resx` files with Chinese variants, representing ongoing localization work. This is a distinct documentation/configuration category.

---

### 7. Boilerplate

- **`*.Designer.cs` files** for every `Form`: `MainForm.Designer.cs`, `AddServerForm.Designer.cs`, etc. — all machine-generated WinForms designer output with no engineering authorship signal.

- **`BaseForm`, `BaseServerForm`** bodies: both are near-empty shells (2–5 non-trivial lines each) with no logic, serving only as inheritance anchors.

---

### 8. Cleanup

- **Pervasive commented-out code blocks**: throughout `ConfigHandler.cs`, `StatisticsHandler.cs`, `V2rayConfigHandler.cs`, and `ShareHandler.cs`, there are extensive `//` blocks of superseded logic kept in-place. Examples: `ConfigHandler.cs` L79-84 (HTTP inbound), L98-101 (domainMatcher), L146-149 (remoteDNS), `ShareHandler.cs` L99-105 (old SS URL format). These represent cleanup work that was *not* yet done — residual debt visible at this snapshot.

- **`SaveRouting` empty loop** ([`ConfigHandler.cs` L1306-1309](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L1306-1309)): `foreach (var item in config.routings) { }` — an empty iteration body, likely a planned-but-not-implemented validation pass, left as dead code.

---

### 9. Test Generation

**Not evidenced.** There are no test files, no test projects, no `xunit`/`MSTest`/`NUnit` references in the `.sln` or `.csproj`. The stratum contains zero automated test coverage.

---

### Taxonomy Refinement Proposal

The existing eight categories cover this codebase adequately with one addition:

> **Data/Schema Migration** (propose as distinct from *dependency migration*): `UpgradeServerVersion` ([`ConfigHandler.cs` L605](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L605)) and `AddServerCommon`'s `configVersion = 2` stamp represent a *user-data format migration* applied at load time — semantically distinct from library dependency upgrades and not cleanly captured by "localized bug fix" or "refactor." In GUI desktop applications that persist user config to local JSON, in-place schema migration is a recurring and identifiable task shape.

---

### 2. Localized Bug Fix

Several code sites carry the unmistakable signature of narrow corrective patches rather than design:

- **`UpgradeServerVersion`** ([`ConfigHandler.cs` L605–663](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L605-663)): migrates a legacy `requestHost` encoding (`path;host` joined by semicolon) to the split `path`/`requestHost` fields introduced at `configVersion = 2`. This is a data-migration fix for a prior design mistake. The silent `catch {}` at L659 is a further tell.

- **`AddServerCommon`** sort value logic ([L790-791](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L790-791)): `maxSort++` is called but the post-increment value is never stored — `vmessItem.sort = maxSort++` assigns the value *before* increment. This is almost certainly a latent bug, not a fix, but indicates the sort field was bolted on after initial implementation.

- **`GetTcpingTime`** ([`SpeedtestHandler.cs` L212](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/SpeedtestHandler.cs?L212)): uses `timer.Elapsed.Milliseconds` (the fractional milliseconds component, max 999) rather than `TotalMilliseconds`. This is a pre-existing latent bug, visible as residual debt at this commit.

- **`ResolveSip002`** 2022-blake3 branch ([`ShareHandler.cs` L561](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ShareHandler.cs?L561)): the `if (rawUserInfo.Contains(":"))` guard was added to handle a new format where credentials are not base64-encoded. This has the shape of a targeted compatibility fix.

- **`SetDefaultServer` overload** ([`ConfigHandler.cs` L349](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L349)): the dual-list fallback pattern (`lstVmess` first, then `config.vmess`) reads as a fix for a race condition or stale-state bug where the active server wasn't being found in the filtered list.

---

### 3. Refactor

- **`BaseForm` / `BaseServerForm` inheritance hierarchy** ([`BaseForm.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Forms/BaseForm.cs), [`BaseServerForm.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Forms/BaseServerForm.cs)): the thin base classes share a static `config` field and custom icon loading, suggesting prior per-form duplication was consolidated.

- **`AddServerCommon`** ([`ConfigHandler.cs` L768](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L768)): extracts shared pre/post-add logic across all five `Add*Server` methods, reducing duplication. The signature and calling pattern is consistent with a refactor that followed the addition of multiple protocol types.

- **`LazyConfig` singleton** ([`LazyConfig.cs` L10](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/LazyConfig.cs?L10)): centralizes config access and core-type resolution previously scattered through `V2rayConfigHandler` and `V2rayHandler`, replacing earlier direct `Config` parameter passing in some paths.

- **`MainFormHandler` singleton** ([L16-18](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/MainFormHandler.cs?L16-18)): several commented-out private fields (`_updateUI`, `downloadHandle2`, `_config`, `_v2rayHandler`, `_selecteds`, `_workThread`) are visible debris from an extraction refactor that moved functionality out of `MainForm` itself.

- **`GetStdTransport` / `ResolveStdTransport`** pair ([`ShareHandler.cs` L185](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ShareHandler.cs?L185) and [L764](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ShareHandler.cs?L764)): symmetric serialization/deserialization helpers extracted to serve both VLESS and Trojan share-URL handling.

---

### 4. Architectural Scaffolding

- **`ECoreType` + `CoreInfo` + `LazyConfig.InitCoreInfo()`**: the pluggable-core architecture ([`ECoreType.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Mode/ECoreType.cs), [`LazyConfig.cs` L67-202](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/LazyConfig.cs?L67-202)) is a designed extensibility scaffold enabling new cores to be added by appending to a registry list. The enum gaps (11–21 suggest reserved space for future proxy-protocol cores vs networking-layer cores) reinforce intentional design.

- **`EConfigType` polymorphism via `VmessItem`**: using a single `VmessItem` entity as a universal server record — with `configType` as discriminant — is an architectural decision to avoid model proliferation. The tradeoff (fields like `alterId`, `flow`, `alpn` are meaningless for many types) is visible debt from this scaffold.

- **`Job` win32 job object for process lifecycle** ([`MainForm.cs` L35](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Forms/MainForm.cs?L35), `Global.processJob`): bootstraps OS-level child-process cleanup so cores are killed when the GUI exits, an infrastructural concern separate from any feature.

- **`Protos/Statistics.proto` + gRPC client generation** ([`.csproj` L47](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/v2rayN.csproj?L47)): the protobuf toolchain integration (`Grpc.Tools`, `<Protobuf Include=...>`) is scaffolding for the statistics subsystem, not a feature per se.

---

### 5. Dependency Migration (evidenced, ambiguous scope)

The [`v2rayN.csproj`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/v2rayN.csproj) declares:

```xml
<TargetFramework>net48</TargetFramework>
<LangVersion>preview</LangVersion>
```

With NuGet packages: `Grpc.Core 2.46.3`, `Google.Protobuf 3.21.5`, `Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.1`, `NHotkey 2.1.0`, `ZXing.Net 0.16.8`, `log4net 2.0.15`.

The `net48` target and `LangVersion=preview` combination suggests a migration from an earlier .NET Framework version (likely .NET 4.5/4.6) occurred at some point in this branch's history. The large commented-out block in [`StatisticsHandler.cs` L39-53](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/StatisticsHandler.cs?L39-53) (manual extraction of native gRPC DLLs) shows a prior approach to gRPC distribution that was superseded by NuGet package management — the fossil of a dependency migration. **Ambiguity**: without commit history accessible at this hash, the exact migration boundary cannot be confirmed from code alone.

---

### 6. Documentation / Configuration

- **Embedded sample files** ([`.csproj` L26-35](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/v2rayN.csproj?L26-35)): `SampleClientConfig.txt`, `SampleServerConfig.txt`, `SampleInbound.txt`, and four `custom_routing_*` files are shipped as embedded resources. These are configuration templates, not code.

- **`Global.cs` constant block** ([L8-225](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Global.cs?L8-225)): the `#region 常量` section (eleven core release URLs, protocol constants, cipher lists, domain strategy lists) is effectively application configuration stored in code rather than in a config file. Additions to these lists (`ssSecuritysInSagerNet`, `fingerprints`, `domainStrategy4Freedoms`) represent documentation/configuration tasks.

- **Bilingual error messages** (`ResUI` resource class, `.zh-Hans.resx` files per form): all UI-facing strings are externalized into `.resx` files with Chinese variants, representing ongoing localization work. This is a distinct documentation/configuration category.

---

### 7. Boilerplate

- **`*.Designer.cs` files** for every `Form`: `MainForm.Designer.cs`, `AddServerForm.Designer.cs`, etc. — all machine-generated WinForms designer output with no engineering authorship signal.

- **`BaseForm`, `BaseServerForm`** bodies: both are near-empty shells (2–5 non-trivial lines each) with no logic, serving only as inheritance anchors.

---

### 8. Cleanup

- **Pervasive commented-out code blocks**: throughout `ConfigHandler.cs`, `StatisticsHandler.cs`, `V2rayConfigHandler.cs`, and `ShareHandler.cs`, there are extensive `//` blocks of superseded logic kept in-place. Examples: `ConfigHandler.cs` L79-84 (HTTP inbound), L98-101 (domainMatcher), L146-149 (remoteDNS), `ShareHandler.cs` L99-105 (old SS URL format). These represent cleanup work that was *not* yet done — residual debt visible at this snapshot.

- **`SaveRouting` empty loop** ([`ConfigHandler.cs` L1306-1309](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L1306-1309)): `foreach (var item in config.routings) { }` — an empty iteration body, likely a planned-but-not-implemented validation pass, left as dead code.

---

### 9. Test Generation

**Not evidenced.** There are no test files, no test projects, no `xunit`/`MSTest`/`NUnit` references in the `.sln` or `.csproj`. The stratum contains zero automated test coverage.

---

### Taxonomy Refinement Proposal

The existing eight categories cover this codebase adequately with one addition:

> **Data/Schema Migration** (propose as distinct from *dependency migration*): `UpgradeServerVersion` ([`ConfigHandler.cs` L605](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L605)) and `AddServerCommon`'s `configVersion = 2` stamp represent a *user-data format migration* applied at load time — semantically distinct from library dependency upgrades and not cleanly captured by "localized bug fix" or "refactor." In GUI desktop applications that persist user config to local JSON, in-place schema migration is a recurring and identifiable task shape.
